mapper.select: SELECT DASHBRD_ID AS dashbrdId , CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , MBRSH_SQ AS mbrshSq , CAST(LAYOUT_JSON AS CHAR) AS layoutJson , CAST(CONFIG_JSON AS CHAR) AS configJson , USE_FL AS useFl , CREATION_ID AS creationId , DATE_FORMAT(CREATION_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS creationDt , UPDATE_ID AS updateId , DATE_FORMAT(UPDATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateDt FROM CM_DASHBRD WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND MBRSH_SQ = #{mbrshSq} AND IFNULL(USE_FL, 'Y') = 'Y' LIMIT 1

SELECT DASHBRD_ID AS dashbrdId , CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , MBRSH_SQ AS mbrshSq , CAST(LAYOUT_JSON AS CHAR) AS layoutJson , CAST(CONFIG_JSON AS CHAR) AS configJson , USE_FL AS useFl , CREATION_ID AS creationId , DATE_FORMAT(CREATION_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS creationDt , UPDATE_ID AS updateId , DATE_FORMAT(UPDATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateDt FROM CM_DASHBRD WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND MBRSH_SQ IS NULL AND IFNULL(USE_FL, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY CREATION_DT ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT A.WIDGET_ID AS widgetId , A.WIDGET_NAME AS widgetName , A.DATASET_ID AS datasetId , A.STYLE_ID AS styleId , A.CATEGORY_CD AS categoryCd , CAST(A.MAPPING_JSON AS CHAR) AS mappingJson , CAST(A.CONFIG_JSON AS CHAR) AS configJson , CAST(A.FILE_SQ AS CHAR) AS fileSq , A.USE_FL AS useFl , A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd FROM CM_WIDGET A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND IFNULL(A.USE_FL, 'Y') = 'Y'
AND A.CATEGORY_CD = #{categoryCd}
AND A.WIDGET_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
ORDER BY A.WIDGET_ID ASC
